prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Héctor, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Héctor thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown on our bins next month with brutal, predatory fines for even a minute of delay. They are clearly looking for any excuse to bleed us dry, so prepare yourselves for constant surveillance."
text: The council is launching a total war on our neighborhood, implementing aggressive surveillance to trap us with predatory fines for the slightest bin delay. They are clearly planning to bankrupt every single one of us, so expect them to be watching our driveways around the clock.
